Design review found that the generic TikTok state check derives the ID field from the path segment after /v1.3/ (smart_plus, so smart_plus_id) and would reject every Smart+ read; the family validates its own reads by the documented campaign_id, adgroup_id and smart_plus_ad_id fields.
